summary: Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare approved the wearable Optune Pax Tumor Treating Fields device with first-line gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel for adults with unresectable locally advanced pancreatic cancer. PANOVA-3 provides randomized evidence of a modest overall-survival improvement over chemotherapy alone. A peer-reviewed prespecified secondary analysis found stable global health status in both groups and longer deterioration-free survival for global health status and pain with Optune Pax.

headlines.summary: FDA granted accelerated approval to dostarlimab for adults with previously untreated Stage II/III dMMR or MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer. Patients with a clinical complete response can enter intensive non-operative surveillance, creating an approved immunotherapy-first organ-preservation pathway while confirmatory clinical benefit remains required.
